entries.name: Benjamin Spock

expected.charges: Conspiracy to counsel, aid, and abet draft resistance.
expected.sentence:
Two years, but he was freed pending appeal and served no time; the conviction was overturned in 1969.

Verdict as recorded: Yes — convicted in June 1968; the conviction was reversed on appeal in 1969 (acquitted).

Charges as recorded: Conspiracy to counsel, aid, and abet draft resistance during the Vietnam War (the "Boston Five" case).

entries.reason: Contemporary July 10, 1968 Boston dispatch establishes sentencing that day. Execution stayed for appeal; preserve null incarceration and release fields. No two-year time-served counter created.
